results.content:
The data shows that since this summer, fewer people than ever approve of Trump’s performance as president.

In 2018, 41% of people strongly approved of Trump’s job as president. By July of this year, only 24% of respondents strongly approved. That number dropped to 22% in August and then 19% in September.

It is now at its lowest point in either of Trump’s terms in office.
